meta.description: A Next.js website for Idaho-grown small-batch salsa.

routes./: Single-page public site with anchored Home, About, Products, Where to Buy, and Contact sections.
routes./api/pageview: POST endpoint that records a pageview when Redis is available.
routes./api/stats: GET endpoint that reads analytics without mutating counters.

visualRules.productCards: Jar-label surfaces with heat accents, not large glowing gradient tiles.
visualRules.largeSections: No hover-scaling on full content sections.
visualRules.heatScale: Rendered as lightweight UI marks in HeatScale.jsx.
